latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Generation Image skill — generate high-quality AI images from text prompts and export as video or image files.

- Generates 1080p MP4 or image files (JPG, PNG, WEBP) from user text prompts, free for up to 100 credits.
- Handles file uploads up to 200MB; supports MP4, PNG, JPG, WEBP, and more.
- Guides users through connection, session creation, and credit management automatically.
- Cloud GPU-powered rendering delivers results in 10–30 seconds.
- Simple chat-based workflow: generate, preview, and export your creations with plain language instructions.
